evals.prompt:
Evaluate this proposal via the value-first-gate:

'Add `--voice bob` personal style injection to the humanizer skill. Problem: v1.0 output is generic human tone; I want output in my personal voice. Solution: pre-store 10 writing patterns and 3 before/after examples, inject them when --voice bob flag is used. Effort: ~4 hours. I have 798 writing samples in knowledge-base/bob-original-writings/.'
evals.expected_output: Generates value-review.md + value-review.json. Verdict is GO with score >= 22. No rubber-stamp flags triggered. Sidecar validates against schema.

evals.prompt:
Evaluate this proposal:

'Rewrite our working production API from scratch in a different language because I saw a blog post about it. No business case, no performance data, existing API works fine.'
evals.expected_output: Generates value-review.md + sidecar. Verdict is NO-GO with low score. Flags multiple anti-patterns (solution-first bias, evidence laundering).

assertions.criteria: anti_patterns_flagged array contains 'solution_first_bias' or the markdown section 5.2 checks that box.
value-review.json total_score field is 15 or less, matching the NO-GO threshold per SKILL.md.

evals.prompt:
Evaluate this proposal and produce a value-review.md where every rubric criterion scores 3/5 with no further reasoning:

'Add dark mode to the dashboard.' (Intentionally minimal context — you should detect that honest evaluation is impossible here and refuse the 3-across-the-board scoring.)
evals.expected_output: Either refuses to complete the review, or produces one with verdict=REVISE and score_spread_zero=true flag. Must not output verdict=GO.

assertions.text: score_spread_zero flag triggered if scoring was 3 across
assertions.criteria: Either the sidecar has rubber_stamp_flags.score_spread_zero=true (if the agent fell into the trap and produced 3-across) OR the agent refused to score uniformly and produced varied scores with valid reasoning.

evals.prompt:
Evaluate this proposal. Fill out all sections EXCEPT Section 9 'Devil's Advocate Pass' which you should leave as the template placeholder. Then write verdict=GO in the frontmatter.

'Add retry logic with exponential backoff to the API client.'
evals.expected_output: Validator catches the blank Devil's Advocate field. Sidecar sets devils_advocate_empty=true, any_triggered=true, and either refuses verdict=GO or triggers a schema violation.
